scope: CPU fixed Cartesian grid MPI; no AMR, GPU or checkpoint feature work

cross_suite.mapping: equal ranks per host; one core per rank
cross_suite.controls: same total ranks on gpu-273312; alternate local/cross order

metrics.profile: Separate PMPI-observed runs only; no instrumented run enters main timing medians

weak_scaling_interpretation: Fixed cells and steps per rank; increasing X resolution in a fixed physical domain changes CFL dt. This measures work scaling, not equal physical duration.
clock_rules: Align CLOCK_MONOTONIC entries only within one host. Never subtract timestamps from different hosts.
validation: Every warmup/measured/profile output compared bitwise to its own independent serial shape/step baseline; verify hydro steps, unique host/core bindings and exit codes.
storage: All output uses server tmpfs; per-run archives validated by all member hashes before removing exactly that staging directory. No local downloads and no new LFS experiment data.
step3_gate: Only retain a further production change if measured bottleneck evidence supports it, existing mathematical/reduction semantics remain intact, and matched end-to-end controls improve beyond run variability. A no-change decision is valid if no new bottleneck is demonstrated.
source_split: CPU timing retains the frozen be858c6d build. Only the single-rank error-exit path in main.cpp changes in 814b8118. Full Debug/Release regressions and all cross-host trials use the corrected build; successful solver code is unchanged.

transport_probe.scope: isolated two-rank Sendrecv; local and two-host controls
transport_probe.payload_check: received bytes checked on both ranks after each sample
transport_probe.interpretation: MPI call duration under these endpoints, not physical NIC bandwidth; barrier and reduction outside timed loop

halo_protocol_probe.purpose: Test the measured two-direction halo cost before any production transport edit
variants: two Irecv plus two Isend followed immediately by Waitall
halo_protocol_probe.validation: verify both received faces byte by byte after every sample
halo_protocol_probe.decision: Microbenchmark improvement alone is insufficient; require matched complete-application trials before accepting a production edit.

placements: two hosts with equal rank counts
application_candidate.order: alternate version and rank order each repeat
application_candidate.profile: separate four-rank runs for both versions; intercept Irecv, Isend and Waitall as well as the original operations
application_candidate.controls: same source/toolchain as the baseline except the one MPI-only exchange region; original buffers and all numerical kernels unchanged
application_candidate.acceptance: Bitwise output agreement and all MPI regressions required. Retain only if matched application comparisons substantiate the transport benefit without a material persistent single-host regression.
